data.purpose: Every live-updating numeric field (gaps, lap times, sectors, positions) — always tabular-nums monospace.

shadows.name: card-shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: shadcn Card's only shadow — the system is flat by default, see the Flat-By-Default Rule.

motion.name: flip-reorder
motion.purpose: Timing tower FLIP-style reorder when driver positions change.

motion.name: dot-glide
motion.purpose: Circuit map driver dot movement between position polls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button — near-white on near-black.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard elevated surface — the system's one 'elevated' tone, flat shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 20px; }

components.name: Timing Row
components.description: Signature data row — timing tower / sector heatmap. Team-color bar, tabular-nums values, zebra striping via row-void/row-recede.
components.css: .ds-timing-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 6px; background: #0a0a0a; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); font-size: 12px; } .ds-timing-pos { width: 24px; text-align: center; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); } .ds-timing-bar { width: 4px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #3671C6; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-timing-code { width: 40px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-timing-gap { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); }

components.name: Driver Chip
components.description: Small reusable driver identity pill — team-color dot + code.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #3671C6; }

narrative.overview: This is instrumentation, not a marketing surface — a pit-wall engineer's live display, not a consumer dashboard. The canvas is near-black by default and stays out of the way; color is not decoration, it is data — a driver's team hex, a tyre compound's FIA color, a gain/loss sign. Density is a feature: the timing tower holds 22 drivers x 5 fields, the sector heatmap holds 22 x 4 cells, and nothing here is allowed to ask for more room than a real broadcast timing screen would give it. The system today is genuinely flat: shadcn's default Card uses only shadow-sm, and most visual separation comes from 10%-opacity hairline borders and background-tone steps, not elevation. Motion is scarce and earns its place.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas, data supplies the color, not the chrome
Flat by default — hairline borders and tone steps over shadows
Motion only where it tracks a real state change

rules.name: The Data Supplies Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays neutral zinc. Color only appears to report a fact (team, compound, gain/loss).

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change between renders is font-mono tabular-nums, full stop.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Step the background tone or add a hairline border before reaching for a shadow.

dos: Do keep the canvas near-black and let team/compound/status colors carry all the meaning.
Do use tabular-nums monospace on every value that updates live.
Do step background tone instead of reaching for a shadow.
Do animate only real state changes.
donts: Don't build generic SaaS/Material-style nested card-in-card containers.
Don't use light-mode data tables or components.
